question: Select the synonym of **Exaggerate.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Amplify**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Exaggerate"** means to represent something as being larger, greater, or more important than it actually is. (बढ़ा-चढ़ाकर कहना)

 
 
• **Example:** He tends to exaggerate his achievements in front of others.
 
 
 
• **"Amplify"** means to increase the magnitude or strength of something, often by adding details or making it more intense. (विस्तार देना)
 
 
• **Example:** The speaker used a microphone to amplify his voice for the large audience.
 
 
 
• Thus, the synonym of **'Exaggerate' **is **'Amplify'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Amplify**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Minimize **(कम करना): To reduce something to the smallest possible amount or degree.

 
 
• **Example:** The company is trying to minimize expenses to increase profitability.
 
 
 
• **Suppress **(दबाना): To restrain or put an end to something by force.
 
 
• **Example:** The government tried to suppress the protests with strict measures.
 
 
 
• **Understate **(कम महत्व देना): To present something as being smaller, less important, or less serious than it really is.
 
 
• **Example:** He understated the impact of the storm on his business.
